notes.title: Goodbye Summer 2025. Hello Beach Vacation Sim!
notes.notes: [p]Didn't get a chance to catch the beach this summer? Don't worry about it. We got you![/p][p][/p][p]With the Steam Summer Postcard 2025 event, Beach Vacation Simulator is now released! Come chill by the ocean and do ABSOLUTELY NOTHING. [/p][p][/p][p]Soak in the ocean [u]visually[/u]. [/p][p][/p][p]Be calmed by the waves [i]audibly[/i]. [/p][p][/p][p]And be reborn [b]spiritually[/b].[/p]

notes.title: Demo Released
notes.notes:
Demo has been released!

More features are coming but you can dive right into the relaxing beach and chill there for as long as your heart desires!
